issues.title: Circular/Self-Referential Acceptance Criteria
issues.why: AC-01 through AC-08 in both 97-acceptance-criteria files verify structural metadata (banners, filenames) rather than the logic of the issue tracker or audit schema.
issues.fix: Add GWT cases for the Issue Record Contract validation logic and the supersession routing logic.

issues.title: Missing Concrete Issue Examples
issues.why: While the spec defines schemas and audit findings, it lacks a complete 'worked example' file showing a single issue from discovery to resolution in the required format.
issues.fix: Add a '03-sample-issue.md' file containing a fully populated issue following the Phase2GitLogsIssue schema.

issues.title: Unresolved Linter Script Dependencies
issues.why: The spec mandates specific python/node scripts (e.g., check-spec-cross-links.py) for verification, but their interface/contract is not defined in this context.
issues.fix: Add a '96-tooling-interface.md' defining the CLI arguments and exit codes for the required linter scripts.
